'''Business and economy'''
*[[Effects of Hurricane Katrina in New Orleans]]
**It is announced that the abandoned [[Six Flags New Orleans]] [[amusement park]], which has been closed since [[Hurricane Katrina]] struck the park and [[New Orleans]], will be demolished beginning next month. Bayou Phoenix is expected to rebuild the area as a [[United States dollar|$]]500 million complex with youth sports fields, hotels, shops, a movie studio and a [[Water park|waterpark]]. [https://www.axios.com/local/new-orleans/2024/08/29/six-flags-theme-park-abandoned-katrina-demolition-starting-september (Axios)]
